answer_1.quote: Open-ended text generation tasks involve generating coherent and fluent output with limited input information . These tasks encompass various applications such as chit-chat dialog , story generation , and similar domains.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the quality of our generated texts using various automatic metrics, including diversity, MAUVE , coherence , greedy ratio , and gen-length.

answer_3.quote: We employ the large language model text-davinci-003 as an evaluator surrogate.

answer_4.quote: We engaged two English language experts.
answer_4.guideline: Assess and select superior sentences based on three criteria: consistency, fluency, and informativeness.
